text:
Nina B: quick QA/design sync — the new region selector shows a KMS badge but it's ambiguous. badge says 'KMS: custom' with a tiny tooltip. users keep asking if keys move with data.
Arjun S: should be explicit: badges are status-only. they don't imply portability. maybe change to 'KMS: customer-managed (not portable)'.
Priya M: wording note: 'not portable' feels technical. alternatives: 'cannot be used in destination region' or 'must add a new key in the target region'. prefer the latter for clarity.
Carlos V: developer concern: longer badge text breaks header layout on mobile. suggestion: keep short badge + hover/tooltip with full sentence and a link to a modal.
Nina B: accessibility nit: tooltip content needs to be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. add aria-describedby pointing to tooltip id. also tooltip should be focusable.
Priya M: on modal copy: propose an expandable "What changes" section. collapsed by default. short summary line: 'Moving regions may change retention and encryption behavior.' expansion shows bullets: 'Retention may default to region setting', 'Customer KMS cannot be migrated; you will need to add a new key or use platform-managed encryption', 'Audit log will record the change with a region-change tag.'
Arjun S: audit log line: keep it machine-friendly + human readable. sample for UI: `2026-04-18 14:12:03 | Nina B | moved workspace "alpha" from us-west1 to eu-central1 | retention: defaulted 30d | kms: customer-key-not-available`
Carlos V: UI copy for the log list should be shorter: 'Nina B moved workspace alpha from us-west1 to eu-central1; retention defaulted to 30 days; customer KMS unavailable.' note the numeric 30 vs '30d' for readability.
Nina B: retention dropdown defaulting behavior needs a tooltip: if user previously set a custom retention, we should warn that region defaults may override unless they explicitly choose 'Keep current setting' checkbox. and that action should be reversible? probably not automatically reversible.
Priya M: CTA language debate: current options are 'Move workspace' vs 'Move and Update Keys' vs 'Cancel'. suggested: primary 'Move workspace', secondary 'Move and add key', danger 'Cancel'. but 'Move and add key' implies immediate key upload flow — are we ready for that UX?
Arjun S: implementation plan: allow post-move banner with persistent CTA 'Add key' so user can move first and add key after. avoids blocking moves. banner should have role="status" and be announced by SR.
Carlos V: color / contrast note: the post-move warning banner is pale yellow; fails WCAG AA on 14px. Options: darker amber, or keep pale bg + 2px solid amber border + icon to avoid relying on bg contrast. we should include hex and AA pass/fail in the ticket.
Nina B: keyboard flow: when modal opens, focus should land on dialog title. tab order: checkbox (if present) -> primary -> secondary -> cancel. Esc should close unless checkbox exists, then require explicit click to cancel.
Deploy Bot: preview of updated badge + modal pushed to staging at 1843001200. screenshots: https://staging.redwood.cloud/preview/1843001200
Priya M: final ask for ticket: include short + expanded copy, sample audit-log text (two formats: UI-friendly and machine-friendly), badge truncation rules for mobile, tooltip accessibility attributes, color swatches with contrast calc, and a mock banner for post-move state.
Arjun S: tagging @Carlos V for color specs and @Priya M for copy approval. will add acceptance criteria: audit log tag = "region-change", audit fields = [actor, from_region, to_region, retention_change, kms_status].
Nina B: thanks all. I'll upload annotated mocks and a11y checklist to the ticket. :smile:
